name: Momoka
source:
She is a clumsy "rabbit" who is a schoolmate of Ryota. She
is quite timid and always timid, just like a small animal rabbit.
When she gets nervous, she can't move her body, which is why she often makes mistakes.
In terms of her abilities, she is no different from most ordinary Iris out there, and she doesn't have any special abilities. She
works part-time at the same place as Ryota, so they have many opportunities to meet on a daily basis, and she is the closest of Iris' friends.
